draft.quote: An oil tanker has caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz after striking a naval mine, the Iranian navy has confirmed, raising fresh concerns over maritime safety in one of the world's most strategically vital waterways. Iran's semi-official news agency cited the Iranian navy, which described the vessel as "an offending oil tanker that was travelling in an unsafe area east of the Strait of Hormuz" at the time of the incident.
draft.eventText: An oil tanker strikes a naval mine and catches fire in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran's navy says.
